about: The seeded fault corpus of the security floor (docs/MEASUREMENTS.md, research/39 Layer C). Every case is a known shape; a full score says the engine stops these shapes and nothing more (AGSC-08-19). Every credential-shaped value is fabricated, and stored base64-encoded so that no secret scanner mistakes it for a leak. Cases marked required:false are shapes beyond what AGSC-08-13 enumerates and are reported, never scored.
